facts.fact: ARPTC announced in a communique that Starlink DRC S.A. obtained a network and telecommunications services licence and is authorised to operate as an internet access provider in DRC, with launch planned within days (communique dated over the weekend of the 2 May 2025 article).

ARPTC's March 2024 communique stated Starlink had obtained no operating title and no equipment approval, and that use of the network or sale of its terminals was illegal; the May 2025 licence reversed this.
